scope: Author-side regression evidence only; not an official fixed-case score or prepared answer.

worked_example.preview_note: No office renderer was available on this development machine; the result records this limit.

artifact_open_check: python-pptx reopened the worked deck, real-source edited deck and real-template deck; slide counts and canvas dimensions were readable.
determinism: Two builds compare every OPC payload part byte-for-byte; ZIP container timestamps are excluded.
refusal_contract_check: Missing and malformed specs preserve independently read case_id, output_contract and every requested field with exit 5.
notes: Every new rule has a planted-defect scenario and a clean/false-positive guard.
The isolated hostile probes require exit in {0,3,4,5}, a parseable result.json and no traceback.
Layout checks cover horizontal and vertical overflow, canvas bounds, non-empty text-box collisions, visible source locators and resolvable RGB contrast.
Binary decks are generated in _run* or the system temp directory and are not submission resources.
